parsed.draft_response:
apologetic
Thanks for flagging this—I'm sorry the Salesforce sync failures are blocking reporting for ~40 enterprise customers right after the v2.8 upgrade. We’ve escalated this for human engineering review to get eyes on the auth token refresh errors and confirm what changed in/around v2.8.

To help us move faster, could you share the minimum details below?
1) Confirm the environment: did the v2.8 upgrade happen in production (not staging)?
2) Paste 5–10 representative log lines showing the auth token refresh error, including exact error text/codes and timestamps.
3) Confirm the Salesforce authentication method in use for the failing connection (e.g., OAuth flow/type) and whether any credentials (client secret/token/connected app) were rotated or reconfigured during/after the upgrade.
4) Does this affect all Salesforce connections, or only specific enterprise customer accounts?

If you’ve already attempted any mitigation (e.g., re-connecting Salesforce, forcing a token refresh, or any rollback steps), please include what you tried and the outcome.

We understand you have a renewal call tomorrow; we’ll keep this moving with the engineering team while we review the logs and configuration details you provide.
